slides.title: Ask before acting
slides.subtitle: Patterns for AI features that people can trust and steer

slides.title: What goes wrong today
bullets: The assistant acts first and explains later, if at all
Progress is a spinner, so people can't tell stuck from slow
There is no way to stop halfway without losing work
Undo exists, but only for some actions and nobody knows which

left.heading: Confirm every step
left.text: Safe, but people stop reading after the third prompt and approve everything. The check stops being a check.

right.heading: Show the plan once
right.text: One preview of everything the assistant will do, with each step editable. People read it because it's the only ask.

stats.label: Hold to delete
stats.note: Long enough to mean it, short enough not to annoy.

stats.label: Undo window
stats.note: The toast timer pauses while the pointer is on it.

stats.label: Drag to archive
stats.note: Past this, letting go archives. Before it, the card springs back.

steps.heading: Preview
steps.text: Show what will happen, in the user's words, before anything changes.

steps.heading: Approve
steps.text: One clear yes or no. Editing a step is also an answer.

steps.heading: Run visibly
steps.text: Name each step as it happens and keep Stop in reach.

steps.heading: Report
steps.text: Say what changed, what didn't, and how to undo it.

slides.quote: People trust what they can see coming.
